sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

To avoid these obstacles, players must time their jumps and net throws perfectly. The game requires quick reflexes and good timing, making it a great game for players who enjoy fast-paced arcade games. The game also features a variety of power-ups that can be collected to give players an edge over their opponents.
